lines.text: The Earth Federation, the first unifying body for all of
humanity, marks the beginning of the New Correct Century in
2000, and the beginning of humankind's expansion into space.
Some say it was also the beginning of a new era of war.
The battle between the Earthnoids and Spacenoids that began
with the One Year War raged on through Char's Rebellion,
giving way to the so-called 10 Year Void.
Now, 100 years later, humans have become a truly
interstellar species, and it feels as though yet another new
era is approaching.
For years, humankind knew of a race of intelligent
extraterrestrial life forms known as the Gamillans.
The Federation was in shambles, despite having rebuffed the
Jupiter Empire in the Jupiter War.
Once the Gamillans invaded, it seemed the Federation would
be destroyed for good. The Gamillan Pluto Frontline Base
then fired a Planet Bomb at Earth, with devastating
consequences. Its back against the wall, the Federation
gambled on a last stand with the Gamillans near Pluto.
In the midst of the M Operation, an escape pod containing
one of Earth's last hopes lands on Mars...
Space Battleship Kirishima, the sole surviving battleship of
the M Operation, makes its way back to Earth with the
capsule collected from the escape pod on Mars.
Meanwhile, a woman on Earth awaits the arrival of another
symbol of hope from the moon.
